title: a walked goal's test check the permanent suite already runs graduates to one check per crate and per case tree
scope:
what the floor carries in from a walked goal's `cargo-named` and `nvs-suite` checks, and what `bun nv chain --check`
holds them to. It changes no goal record and nothing a check runs.
validatedBy: `tools/nv/test/chain.test.ts`, and `bun nv chain --check` over the chain's walked goals.
